metadata.description: Portable, AI-agnostic safety harness for coding agents

plugins.name: agent-harness
plugins.description: Curated review/build/test agents + secret-hardening/worktree/plan-gate hooks + supervise/wrap skills. Install once, use in every project.

plugins.name: agent-harness-extras
plugins.description: Rarely used agent-harness skills (code-tour, harness-audit, harness-loop, loop, manager-audit, persona-review, reorg-sync, worker-setup, brain-ingest). Optional companion to agent-harness; install with /plugin install agent-harness-extras@agent.
